lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I've set a return signal at the gate. It keeps running while I'm away.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: And if the watch breaks?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I don't have an answer for that yet.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Then be careful with it. And with yourself.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'll come back as soon as I've checked the other side.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Good. Start with that.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: One more thing.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: It stopped.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Only that part. Only for a few seconds.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: I preferred it when you repaired clocks.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Technically—

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Don't.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Not even their names.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'll come back.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Then I'll leave the lamp on.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Thank you. For staying with me.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Come back and tell me properly.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: That strap was coming loose.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I was going to fix it.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: I know.

choices.label: Thank you. For staying with me.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Harbor's down there. Market's behind you. Try not to fall off either.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I thought this street was gone.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Gone where?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Never mind.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: You should sit down.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The roofs…

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Are you lost?

choices.label: I thought this street was gone.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Is there somewhere I can get some water?

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: The clinic. Blue shutters. Door's already open.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Tell him I'm not running on it.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Running on what?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'll bring it.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Thank you. Tell her it's for the clinic.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I need a moment first.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Take one. The water isn't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Sit down before you fall down.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'm not hurt.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Then it's only a chair. You can still use it.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Cups are beside the jug.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You let anyone walk in?

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: That's why the door's open.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Feeling better?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Good. Could you spare me a few minutes?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Sela has a parcel of clean linen for us. Her shop is just across the square.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Looking, buying, or bringing bad news?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Collecting linen for the clinic.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: That's almost a purchase.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Take the wrapped one. The loose cloth is for the boats.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Do I owe you anything?

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: He'll settle it. He always does, eventually.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You expecting a storm?

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Tonight. Bad enough that everyone suddenly remembers their roof leaks.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: You came back.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I said I would.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: You'd be surprised how often that isn't enough. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Does Neri come here often?

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Only when the ground wins an argument.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: He says he's not running.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Then I admire his restraint.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Hold that corner. Yes—there.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Will it keep the rain out?

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: It should. We'll put a table beneath it and bring the families through here.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What will you write down?

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Names. Who people are looking for. Where to send word when we find someone.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I thought I was just fixing a roof.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Now they have somewhere to come. It makes a difference.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Pull it toward you. That's it. Tie off that side.

lines.speaker: Neri
lines.text: Can we sleep here now?

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: You can wait here. Ask your mother about sleeping.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Whose book is that?

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: The departure clerk left it. Now everyone can gather here, he can take their names before the boats leave.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: For the fares?

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: For anyone who comes looking after the boat has gone.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Let's see what stayed.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: It wasn't enough.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: To stop any of this.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: You went once. Sit down before you decide what that means.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I changed something.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: I believe you.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Even though you remember it differently?

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: I can see you're trying to tell me the truth.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I don't know what to do next.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Eat. Sleep. Then tell me everything you remember.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: You're shaking.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I don't think I noticed until now.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Did it work?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I was there. Before the roofs fell. Before any of this.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: What was it like?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Loud.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Someone was complaining about the rain. I wanted to tell them how lucky they were.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Did you?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: No. I helped with a roof.

choices.label: I don't know what to do next.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'm going back.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What did the town sound like?

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Before the war?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Before everyone stopped talking about it.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Bells. Boats. People arguing over the price of fish.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: I used to wish it was quieter.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Was there a moment when someone could have stopped it?

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: There were a lot of moments. We just didn't know which ones mattered.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Someone must have known.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Perhaps. The people who survived didn't all tell the same story.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That was supposed to stay there.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: You said that about the last one.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The last one hit the ceiling. This is progress.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Then celebrate with something warm.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The contact slipped again.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: The small piece is in the dish. I moved it before it rolled onto the floor.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: There. Stay this time.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: It's holding.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: For how long?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Longer than yesterday.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Test it again.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Still holding.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: There's one more thing. The courtyard awning came down. I need somewhere for people to wait when the rain starts. Sela was looking for a cover.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'll ask her.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: One good sheet. The others are split.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The clinic needs it.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: So does the harbor waiting shelter. Its cover tore this morning.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Who's waiting there?

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Families leaving on the morning boat. Without a shelter they'll have to find rooms all over town. The clerk was hoping to register them together before they left.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Can we cover both?

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Not with this. Cut it in half and it won't reach either set of fixings. The next supply boat is tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What about the clinic?

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: He can keep his patients inside. There isn't room for all the people coming to ask after relatives. A covered courtyard would give him somewhere to speak with them and take their names.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I'll tell him which place I take it to.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: Good. Don't leave anyone waiting for help that isn't coming.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The courtyard. The waiting shelter.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The clinic courtyard. I'll get the awning back up.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: All right. Take the repair straps too. Bring back whatever you don't use.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The waiting shelter. They need somewhere dry tonight.

lines.speaker: Sela
lines.text: All right. Take the repair straps too. Bring back whatever you don't use.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Let me look at both places first.

choices.label: The clinic courtyard. I'll get the awning back up.
The waiting shelter. They need somewhere dry tonight.
Let me look at both places first.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The harbor still needs a cover.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Then we'll see what we can move inside before the rain. Thank you for telling me.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I used the sheet at the harbor. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Was there only one?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: One that would hold.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Then I'll ask people to wait with their neighbors. You helped where you could.

choices.label: What if something worse is coming?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What if something worse is coming?

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Worse than the storm?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: A war.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Have you heard something?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I know what happens afterward. I don't know where it starts.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Then find something we can act on. A place. A date. Someone we can speak to.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And you'll listen?

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: I'm listening now.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I need to go home.

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Then go. Someone will be waiting.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Will you be here when I come back?

lines.speaker: Healer
lines.text: Most days. You know where the door is.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: This frame was empty.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: They wrote the names down. In the courtyard.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: What are you looking at?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I put up the awning. Before the rain.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: The register's been here for years.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Not for me.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: All right. Tell me.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: There weren't any names here before.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The departure list. They managed to record everyone waiting there.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Whose name are you looking for?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: No one's. I just needed to know they made the list.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: It's been here for years.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I know. That's the strange part.

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text: Come inside. Start at the beginning.

lines.text: You'd have to ask me first.

lines.text: All right. Just this once.
